title: Ivo and the Vow
author: Theo Brightwater
blurb: Felix Eastwick, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
